main_text.l: πλόος ἁπλᾶς duplex: ὁ ἁπλόον ἁπλᾶν simplex, ὁ ἁπλόον ἁπλοῦ̃ duplex. sic
χαλκοῖς, χρυ-σοῖς: ubi accentus est irregularis, pro ἀργύρεος, χάλκοις, χρύσους.
Ἡοφά-λια regalia, Διόσια Jovialia, Διονύσια Li-
Anomalia casus. Genit.singul.Poet. λόγοιο: Dor. λόγω.
Vocativus Attice similis est nominativo. at ὦ
ϑεὸς o Deus, & ὦ ϑεος heus tu, usitata sunt etiam in

l.i: tiva fœminina in os sunt sequentia.

page.notes: Greek and the page's faded, blotted type; several Greek words are doubtful and the transcription of the Greek accents is approximate. The Greek word at the foot right (αἰγυ-) is a catchword.
